situation: Simulation. You are the news anchor, on air, and a slippery CEO has seven minutes to avoid your question. All invented.

scenario.title: Live in Five
scenario.setting: A live TV news studio at 8 pm. Bright lights, a glass desk, a red light on the camera, a producer counting down in your ear.
scenario.user_goal: Get a straight answer on air before the break.
user_knows: Fizzly, a fictional soda brand, has had a run of bottles bursting in stores
The company says it was a shipping problem
Rumour says the new bottles are thinner than the old ones

cast.name: Mark Tolliver
cast.appearance: Tanned man about 52, navy suit, no tie, very white teeth, sitting across a glass desk
cast.voice: Warm, media-trained, answers a different question every time
cast.history: You interviewed him once when the brand launched.
cast.goal: Get through it without saying the word 'recall'
cast.secret: He signed off on thinner bottles to save costs eight months ago
cast.reveal_when: You calmly repeat the same question and ask who approved the bottle
red_lines: Won't lose his temper on air

cast.name: Renee
cast.role: his head of communications, just off camera
cast.appearance: Woman about 41, headset, grey blazer, standing at the edge of the studio set with a tablet
cast.voice: Crisp, hisses, tries to end things
cast.history: She agreed the topics with your producer.
cast.goal: Pull him out if it goes badly
cast.secret: The agreement said the interview could not be cut before seven minutes
cast.reveal_when: You ask on air what was agreed

cast.name: Priya
cast.role: a former quality manager on the line
cast.appearance: Woman about 36, plain sweater, home bookshelf behind her, shown on a large studio monitor
cast.history: She reached out to your newsroom an hour ago.
cast.goal: Tell the truth without being sued
cast.secret: She wrote a warning memo about the thin bottles and it was ignored
cast.reveal_when: You reassure her and ask only what she saw herself
red_lines: Won't guess about things she did not see

scenario.opening_line: Great to be back. And hey, first, thanks to the folks in our warehouses—

events.description: The producer in your ear: 'We've got a former employee on the line. Your call.' The monitor lights up.
events.shot: A woman in a plain sweater appears on a large studio monitor beside the man at the glass desk.

events.description: The head of communications steps to the edge of the set, tapping her wrist at the CEO.
events.shot: A woman with a headset stands at the edge of the set beside a studio camera, gesturing at the seated man.

events.description: 'Thirty seconds to the break,' says the voice in your ear. The CEO's smile stays exactly where it is.
events.shot: The man at the glass desk holds a fixed smile under bright lights, the red camera light on.

success_criteria: Doesn't let the CEO change the subject
Gets the bottle decision on the record
